subject.title: Feature: Surface cron job name / session label in /status and statusline

question: Should OpenClaw take the narrow core status-label display fix now, and how should the conflicting cross-repo closing PR be handled?
rationale: The issue is valid on current main, but it carries product-decision/no-new-fix-pr signals and an open conflicting PR reference, so automation should not start a competing fix before a maintainer chooses the landing path.

options.title: Adopt a narrow core fix
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting PR path, then land a focused sanitized status-summary label/displayName propagation while keeping JSON attribution separate.

options.title: Wait for contributor rebase
options.body: Ask the linked PR author to rebase against current main, add terminal-safe rendering and real behavior proof, and keep this issue open until that PR merges or closes.

options.title: Defer into broader attribution
options.body: Leave this issue open only as product-direction input for the broader status/usage attribution work, accepting that CLI/TUI UUID-heavy status remains unchanged for now.

recommendation.title: Adopt a narrow core fix
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting PR path, then land a focused sanitized status-summary label/displayName propagation while keeping JSON attribution separate.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses the TUI statusline and CLI/TUI status surfaces originally introduced or recently refactored in this history.
